capabilities.name: Controlled Hybrid LLM Rendering Runtime
capabilities.responsibility: Own the existing provider-neutral LLM invocation infrastructure: build and invoke controlled rendering requests as before, expose a shared use-case-neutral text transport for governed callers, parse rendering output, apply deterministic fidelity checks, and retain the deterministic explanation as fallback on rendering provider, structure or fidelity failure.
capabilities.authority_role: Reusable provider-neutral transport and controlled candidate-rendering runtime only. Transport success grants no insurance, interpretation, recommendation, publication or release authority; canonical rendered candidates remain subordinate to Rendering Exit Safety.
safety_invariants: Existing rendering request, response, invocation and fallback behavior remains backward-compatible.
Shared text invocation is bounded by an injected provider-neutral contract, invokes exactly once, and normalizes timeout/provider failure without granting semantic authority.
The deterministic explanation is retained across rendering provider failure, malformed output and fidelity failure.
Structured rendering candidates are parsed and fidelity-validated before the legacy runtime marks them rendered.
Canonical customer release still requires the newer Rendering Exit Safety boundary when the rendering runtime is used through the provider-integration bridge.
No concrete vendor-specific production adapter is implied by the shared transport contract.
capabilities.notes: P1A extends the existing provider-neutral runtime with a shared text transport rather than creating a semantic-interpreter client stack. No concrete vendor-specific production adapter is claimed by this capability.
